# PdfBox-Android 2.0.27.0

Maven coordinate: `com.tom-roush:pdfbox-android:2.0.27.0`.

Local PDF text extraction only. The dependency is not modified. Optional JPX image decoders are not enabled.

- Upstream: https://github.com/TomRoush/PdfBox-Android/tree/v2.0.27.0
- Complete license (including separately attributed components): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TomRoush/PdfBox-Android/v2.0.27.0/LICENSE.txt
- Notices: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TomRoush/PdfBox-Android/v2.0.27.0/NOTICE.txt

The accompanying LICENSE.txt and NOTICE.txt retain the upstream files verbatim. They are included as Android assets so they travel with the APK.
